title: Kissed Garlicky Slovakian Water Chestnut Dumplings
description: A romantic Slovakian dish featuring water chestnut and ferment-kimchi, perfect for a Buddhist-temple-friendly meal. This garlicky and molten dish is sure to delight.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, salt, and black pepper.
Gradually add in the vegetable oil and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a few pieces of water chestnut in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
In a large pot, bring a few inches of water to a boil and add the dumplings.
Cook the dumplings for 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
While the dumplings are cooking, heat the ferment-kimchi in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic to the kimchi and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Serve the dumplings with the garlicky kimchi sauce spooned over the top.
